entry.title: NVIDIA's own fault patterns, caught on a real GPU
entry.summary: The self-test now plants faults shaped like NVIDIA's gate-level measurements. On an RTX 4090 the reference check alone flagged all 294.

entry.title: When ECC is off, the memory error counters cannot see anything
entry.summary: Two rented cards ran with ECC switched off, so their counters could not move. The tester now says so instead of calling them quiet.

entry.title: BF16 matrix multiplies on Intel AMX treat tiny inputs as zero
entry.summary: Above 16 × 16 × 16, BF16 matrix multiplies on AMX CPUs treat subnormal inputs as zero, whatever set_flush_denormal says.
